title: Placement Rules
description: Rules that modify structure around artifact positions during map generation. Each rule has conditions (matching artifact properties) and actions (structure modifications with probabilities).

rules.name: Pedestal for compact artifacts
rules.description: Place compact artifacts on elevated tile (code 2) 60% of the time so players can see them at eye level.

actions.description: Elevate the tile under the artifact

rules.notes: Pedestals create better visibility for small objects. Applies to all compact interaction types.

rules.name: Wall behind small artifacts
rules.description: Place a wall (code 3) behind compact artifacts 50% of the time for visual framing. 'Behind' means row-1 (north) relative to player approach from spawn.
rules.notes: From map analysis: 43% of artifacts have a wall directly north. This creates an alcove/backing effect.

rules.name: Alcove framing for grab artifacts
rules.description: Frame grab artifacts with walls on three sides (behind + left + right) 30% of the time to create a niche/alcove effect.
rules.notes: From map analysis: 71% of artifacts have at least one adjacent wall. Alcove pattern creates intimate interaction space.

rules.name: Extra clearance for manipulate artifacts
rules.description: Ensure manipulate artifacts have at least 2 cells of floor around them by clearing adjacent walls.
rules.notes: Manipulate artifacts need space for player movement during interaction.

rules.name: Raised platform for room-scale artifacts
rules.description: Place room-scale artifacts on a small elevated platform (2x2 or 3x3 of code 4) 40% of the time.
rules.notes: Creates a raised stage effect for larger artifacts. Uses amber code 4 (decorative elevation).
